599:t_102:3.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Everyone rejected the $$時の牢獄$$! I have no intention of listening to your selfish excuses!」

599:t_103:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I'll stop you and end the fighting among humanity here!」

599:t_103:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Then let me ask: if you win, will that mean eternal peace?」

599:t_103:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You seem unsure. That is a natural response.」

599:t_103:4.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「But I can state with certainty that I can bring tranquility to the world.」

599:t_103:5.en:
$$正太郎$$
「You'd just be taking everyone's freedom away! You can't call that peace!」

599:t_103:6.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's go, $$鉄人$$! After we defeat him, people all over the world will build peace together!」

599:t_104:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「If we left Earth to you, we'd get a world without dreams or hope!」

599:t_104:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Are you claiming you can give those things to the people?」

599:t_104:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「Dreams and hopes belong to each person! I'm just fighting to protect them!」

599:t_104:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「Here I come, $$フル・フロンタル$$! I'll end the legend of the Red Comet here!」

599:t_105:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Now that's a machine fit for a final showdown! It looks like it'll be fun to smash!」

599:t_105:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「This $$ネオ・ジオング$$ symbolizes the hope of a new people of space. I cannot let you destroy it.」

599:t_105:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Don't worry! Even if that thing falls, everyone's hopes won't disappear!」

599:t_105:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Because we'll fight to protect them!」

599:t_106:0.en:
$$タケル$$
「The future people wished for isn't a world where they merely survive! It's a world where they live with hope!」

599:t_106:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「There is such a thing as happiness suited to one's station. Sadly, there is not much happiness available to the people living in this world now.」

599:t_106:2.en:
$$タケル$$
「That's a rule you decided on yourself! No one wants a world filled with resignation from the start!」

599:t_106:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「That is your own arbitrary reasoning. As a vessel, I merely act in response to people's desire to survive.」

599:t_106:4.en:
$$タケル$$
「Then we'll win the world everyone wants, beyond you and beyond $$サイデリアル$$'s defeat!」

599:t_107:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「We've come this far, so we don't need arguments! You weren't going to listen to us anyway!」

599:t_107:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「And you have no intention of listening to me.」

599:t_107:2.en:
$$シモン$$
「Then there's only one thing to do! My drill will pierce that new machine you're so proud of, and your ambition!」

599:t_107:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Heh... If the world were as simple and clear-cut as you, things would be much easier.」

599:t_107:4.en:
$$シモン$$
「You're the only one overcomplicating things! I just fight for the ordinary happiness everyone wants!!」

599:t_108:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「This $$ネオ・ジオング$$ will not lose to your machine in power.」

599:t_108:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Don't underestimate the $$ガンバスター$$! Its strength comes from the feelings within it, not raw power!」

599:t_108:2.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Then, as a vessel that gathers people's wills, I shall show you the power of those feelings, too.」

599:t_108:4.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「And we'll stop you here and end the fighting!」

599:t_109:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Snap out of it already! Humanity has to join forces to fight our enormous enemies!」

599:t_109:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Do you mean $$サイデリアル$$? Or $$バアル$$?」

599:t_109:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「That is precisely what is pointless. That is why I will ally with $$サイデリアル$$ and use its power to fight $$バアル$$.」

599:t_109:4.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You'll throw away humanity's freedom and pride for that!?」

599:t_109:5.en:
$$ラルク$$
「That's not an alliance! It's surrender!!」

599:t_110:0.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ and the others will stop you here! Because...!」

599:t_110:1.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「$$ノノ$$ and the others will stop you here! Because...!」

599:t_110:2.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「$$ノノ$$ and the others will stop you here! Because...!」

599:t_110:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I have no time to indulge your nonsense.」

599:t_110:4.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Wait a moment! Don't you want to hear what comes after 'Because...'!?」

599:t_110:5.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Wait a moment! Don't you want to hear what comes after 'Because...'!?」

599:t_110:6.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「Wait a moment! Don't you want to hear what comes after 'Because...'!?」

599:t_110:7.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I've heard enough of the optimistic fantasies you all specialize in.」

599:t_110:9.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「I'll say it anyway! Because...!」

599:t_110:10.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「I'll say it anyway! Because...!」

599:t_110:11.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ and the others believe in hope, in the future, and in victory!」

599:t_110:12.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「$$ノノ$$ and the others believe in hope, in the future, and in victory!」

599:t_110:13.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「$$ノノ$$ and the others believe in hope, in the future, and in victory!」

599:t_111:0.en:
$$葵$$
「I've seen all sorts of villains, but you're something different from any of them.」

599:t_111:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I question whether you have the right to judge me as evil.」

599:t_111:2.en:
$$葵$$
「I don't intend to call myself a champion of justice...」

599:t_111:3.en:
$$葵$$
「But I won't accept someone who twists everyone's desire for a future and can only preserve the status quo!」

599:t_111:4.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Blood of the beast... I see.」

599:t_111:5.en:
$$葵$$
「Here I come, $$フル・フロンタル$$! We'll settle this fight that began in the $$時獄戦役$$!」

599:t_112:0.en:
$$赤木$$
「Stop fighting! If you give in, the fighting among humanity will end!」

599:t_112:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「But a future of despair awaits beyond it.」

599:t_112:2.en:
$$赤木$$
「All humanity will join forces and fight to overcome it!」

599:t_112:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I will not accept a world that demands such sacrifices.」

599:t_112:4.en:
$$赤木$$
「But I can't believe a world where we surrender to $$サイデリアル$$ and survive on its mercy is right!」

599:t_112:5.en:
$$赤木$$
「Everyone can decide what's right together! That's why I'll stop you here to end the fighting!」

599:t_113:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Unfortunately, it seems I cannot overturn your reasoning with words.」

599:t_113:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「To think a negotiator like you would raise the white flag.」

599:t_113:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Do not misunderstand. The reason is that, though you call yourself a vessel, you refuse to accept others.」

599:t_113:3.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「There can be no discussion with such a person.」

599:t_113:4.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Then what will you do?」

599:t_113:5.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Reluctantly, I will stop you by force.」

599:t_113:6.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「That is what the world demands now! I will simply carry it out!」

599:t_114:0.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Whatever words you string together, you're a beaten dog wagging its tail for the Empire!」

599:t_114:2.en:
$$アポロ$$
「I can't let someone like that decide where the world goes!」

599:t_114:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You would irresponsibly strike me down, then? What do you intend to do afterward?」

599:t_114:4.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Everyone living in this world will decide where it goes!」

599:t_114:5.en:
$$アポロ$$
「I'll knock down the pompous fake Red Comet who gets in their way!」

599:t_115:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Do you accept letting the world go on as it is now!?」

599:t_115:2.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「But I believe it is the only way for humanity to survive.」
